hero.heading: From obligation to evidence in one platform
hero.subheading: Jojan One guides your business through five connected stages. Each stage builds on the last, so you always know where you stand and can prove it when it matters.

steps.label: Understand
steps.heading: Know exactly what applies to your business
steps.body: Jojan One maps your business profile sector, size, jurisdiction, and structure against the regulatory landscape. You get a clear, prioritised view of every obligation that applies to you, with nothing irrelevant cluttering the picture.
steps.detail: Our platform continuously monitors legislative and regulatory changes across your jurisdictions, automatically updating your obligation set so you never miss a new requirement.

steps.label: Monitor
steps.heading: Stay ahead of your compliance position
steps.body: Real-time monitoring tracks your compliance status across all 13 modules from GDPR and employment law to governance and contracts. Alerts surface issues before they become problems.
steps.detail: Your Business Confidence Score gives leadership a single, honest number that reflects your true compliance health, updated continuously as your team takes action.

steps.label: Act
steps.heading: Take the right action at the right time
steps.body: Jova, your AI compliance assistant, turns complex obligations into clear, actionable tasks. Assign responsibilities, set deadlines, and track progress all within the platform.
steps.detail: Guided workflows walk your team through each requirement step by step, reducing the risk of errors and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

steps.label: Evidence
steps.heading: Build an unbroken audit trail automatically
steps.body: Every action, document, and decision is timestamped and stored in your evidence vault. Policies, contracts, training records, and sign-offs are linked directly to the obligations they satisfy.
steps.detail: Document generation tools produce compliant policies and agreements in minutes. Your evidence library grows with your business, always ready for inspection.

steps.label: Prove
steps.heading: Demonstrate readiness to anyone who asks
steps.body: Generate board-ready reports, investor packs, and regulator-facing evidence bundles in seconds. Your Business Confidence Score and full audit trail give stakeholders the confidence they need.
steps.detail: Whether it's a due diligence request, a regulatory inspection, or a board meeting, Jojan One gives you the evidence to prove your business is ready.
